data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1 (partial): CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md reflects the new `dso_ci_review/` module layout. References to `llm-api-call.sh` are removed or replaced with module references; references to `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` describe the shim semantics and the underlying module.

## Context
`llm-api-call.sh` was deleted in story e596. `ci-llm-review-runner.sh` is a 29-line shim. CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md has been partially updated with \"shim in S3+; delegates to `python3 -m dso_ci_review.runner`\" annotations in several places, but still uses bash-era language in some descriptions (e.g., \"Rate-limit backoff for CI deep-tier parallel curl calls is handled via `curl --retry`\"). The ci-overlay-flags.md already has accurate shim language but may need minor cleanup.

## Files to Change
- `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md`:
  - Line ~1637: Description says \"Rate-limit backoff for CI deep-tier parallel curl calls is handled via `curl --retry` / `--retry-delay` flags on each request\" — this describes the deleted bash implementation. Update to reflect that the Python module (`dso_ci_review.runner`) handles rate-limit backoff internally.
  - Review all other instances of \"ci-llm-review-runner.sh\" — confirm each accurately describes it as a shim (most already do per grep output; verify and clean up any that still describe it as the primary implementation).
  - Remove any remaining references to `llm-api-call.sh` (grep shows none, but verify).
- `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-overlay-flags.md`:
  - Confirm line 14 \"Written by: `dso_ci_review.runner` (`ci-llm-review-runner.sh` is a shim in S3+)\" is accurate and complete. Minor cleanup only if needed.

## Implementation Steps
1. Grep `CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` for `llm-api-call` and `ci-llm-review-runner` to find all instances.
2. For each instance, verify whether it accurately describes the current state (shim + Python module) or still describes the deleted bash pipeline.
3. Update stale descriptions to reflect Python module reality. Preserve the `# shim-exempt:` annotations (they document why path references are allowed in docs).
4. In the `DSO_ASSETS_DIR` and `review.size_upgrade_threshold` entries, the shim annotation is already present; verify the prose in \"Description\" fields is also accurate.
5. Update line ~1637 to remove the `curl --retry` statement.
6. Verify `ci-overlay-flags.md` is accurate; make minor updates if needed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md contains no reference to `llm-api-call.sh`
  Verify: ! grep -q "llm-api-call" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md does not describe curl-based rate-limit backoff as the current implementation
  Verify: ! grep -q "curl --retry" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] All ci-llm-review-runner.sh references in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md include shim description
  Verify: grep "ci-llm-review-runner" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | grep -qi "shim"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Update CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md and ci-overlay-flags.md shim language to reflect migration complete
